data.description: Genuine High Floor | Upgraded | Luxury Furnished
data.long_description:
Provident Real Estate is proud to present this exceptional upgraded apartment in The Torch, Dubai Marina.

Situated on a high floor, this beautifully maintained residence offers a premium living experience with high-end finishes, elegant upgrades, and luxury furniture throughout. The apartment is fully furnished with carefully selected designer pieces, making it an ideal choice for end-users and investors seeking a turnkey property in one of Dubai Marina's most sought-after towers.

Property Features:
• High Floor
• Fully Upgraded Interior
• Premium Luxury Furniture Included
• Spacious and Bright Layout
• Floor-to-Ceiling Windows
• Modern Open Kitchen
• Well Maintained Condition
• Marina and Community Views
• Ready to Move In

Building Amenities:
• Swimming Pool
• Fully Equipped Gymnasium
• 24/7 Security and Concierge
• Covered Parking
• Walking Distance to Marina Walk
• Easy Access to Sheikh Zayed Road
• Close to Restaurants, Cafes, Retail and Public Transport

The Torch is one of Dubai Marina's most recognized residential towers, offering residents a vibrant waterfront lifestyle with excellent connectivity and world-class amenities.

Contact us today to arrange a viewing and experience this exceptional property firsthand.
